Hannah (CS): Heads-up: IrmIS Labs renewal landed this morning. Procurement is blocking signature until three artifacts: vendor-signed pen-test PDF, SOC2 cert link, and confirmation that KMS key rotation is scheduled. They also want invoice billed to 'IrmIS Labs Ltd' and PO # IL-2024-321.
Julian (AE): Ok. Any asks on pricing or term changes?
Hannah (CS): They're asking to move from annual prepay to annual monthly installments (split invoicing) citing budgeting rules. They asked whether we can provide that and keep the promotional upsell credit we offered.
Marta (Legal): Switching to split invoices is a material commercial change. We can do an amendment that permits installment billing, but Finance must approve payment cadence and Legal will require a payment schedule + proration clause. Also need the pen-test PDF attached before we complete e-sign.
Sam (Finance): Installment billing ok with a slight admin fee (1.5%) and net30 on each invoice. Need their VAT ID and beneficiary bank details to map invoice to 'IrmIS Labs Ltd'. Also require PO to match billing entity.
Hannah (CS): Procurement said they can provide VAT ID and bank details if Legal confirms invoice can be to the UK entity while the contract is signed by the US parent.
Marta (Legal): We can include a billing-entity addendum that allows US parent to sign while invoices go to UK subsidiary, provided an intercompany/reseller addendum or signed confirmation is in the folder. I'll draft the addendum and open a DocuSign envelope.
EnablementBot: Onboarding checklist created: IRMIS-ONB-503 / tracks SSO, KMS rotation proof, webhook allowlist, and production enablement session.
Julian (AE): Procurement wants the pen-test vendor signature page intact; redactions allowed for internal IPs. I asked their security lead for the file 30m ago. Pinged again.
Hannah (CS): Also procurement is asking for a named infra contact to accept the IAM role for KMS rotation evidence. They want rotation proof (audit log) uploaded to our secure portal.
Sam (Finance): If we accept installments, RevOps needs to know for revenue recognition. Julian, loop in RevOps. Also confirm whether admin fee accepted by Sales.
Julian (AE): Looping RevOps now. I'll also offer to waive the admin fee if they provide the vendor-signed pen-test and VAT docs within 5 business days. If not, fee applies.
Marta (Legal): Drafted amendment referencing PO IL-2024-321 and installment schedule. Creating envelope. Will require pen-test attached + VAT docs before execution.
DocuSignBot: Envelope EN-55021 created by Marta (Legal) for IrmIS Labs  Amendment + billing-entity addendum awaiting signature from "CFO - IrmIS Labs Ltd"
Hannah (CS): Quick unblock idea: for KMS we can mark 'rotation scheduled' with a scheduled rotation timestamp and upload the rotation job config; procurement says that is acceptable if we provide a concrete audit timeline. Can Onboarding produce that now?
EnablementBot: KMS minimal evidence template available: https://redwood.atlassian.net/KMS/evidence-template  can be populated and uploaded to contract folder.
Julian (AE): Update: their infra lead (nira.ops@irmis.co.uk) replied and accepted the IAM invite. They said pen-test will be uploaded by end of day. I asked for VAT ID and bank details (IBAN + SWIFT) in the same message.
Sam (Finance): Once VAT ID + IBAN received, Finance will map invoice to 'IrmIS Labs Ltd'. I'll queue the credit check for Net30 installments.
Marta (Legal): Please attach the pen-test PDF (even redacted) and VAT docs to envelope EN-55021. Legal will hold the envelope until those are attached.
Hannah (CS): I'll monitor and upload artifacts to the contract folder. Also the customer asked for a 30m production enablement session the week after sign  Onboarding please hold a slot.
Julian (AE): Reminder: promotional upsell credit expires in 5 business days. If docs + signatures happen within window we keep credit; otherwise it reverts. Calling their procurement lead in 2h if we don't see the upload.
Hannah (CS): Thanks all  I'll post artifacts here when they arrive. :thumbsup:
